name: What are some popular design trends for family room remodels right now?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular design trends for family room remodels right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current family room remodel trends often focus on creating versatile, multi-functional spaces that cater to various activities, from relaxing to working or entertaining. Popular elements include open-concept layouts, durable and easy-to-clean materials, built-in storage solutions to reduce clutter, and a blend of natural light with layered artificial lighting. Neutral color palettes with pops of accent colors, and incorporating sustainable or reclaimed materials, are also frequently requested. We can share examples from recent projects in areas like Kuna and Star to inspire your design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular trends include versatile, multi-functional layouts, durable materials, built-in storage, balanced lighting, neutral palettes with accents, and sustainable materials. We share local project examples.
